label.purpose: Article metadata and recent publication dates.

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: Wrap bold text links and underline the current location.
components.html: WritingAboutProjects
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 clamp(0.85rem, 2.25vw, 1.75rem); font: 700 1.0625rem/1.55 var(--sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-block-size: 2.75rem; color: var(--ink, #182f3b); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.09em; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 0.14em; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration-thickness: 0.16em; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="false"]:not(:hover) { text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #22536c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight; } }

components.name: Reading Action
components.description: A prominent action is an underlined link, not a filled button.
components.css: .ds-read-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-block-size: 2.75rem; color: var(--link, #22536c); font: 700 1.0625rem/1.55 var(--sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.09em; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-read-action:hover { color: var(--link-hover, #122e40); text-decoration-thickness: 0.14em; } .ds-read-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #22536c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-read-action:focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight; } }

components.name: Editorial Sheet
components.description: A flat tinted surface for supporting context.
components.html:
At 10kR

components.css: .ds-sheet { padding: var(--space-3, 1.5rem); color: var(--ink, #182f3b); background: var(--sheet, #e5edf0); font: 400 1.0625rem/1.55 var(--sans, "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0; font: 500 clamp(1.5rem, 2.5vw, 2rem)/1.12 var(--display, "Bodoni Moda", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif); letter-spacing: -0.032em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-sheet p { margin-block: 0.75rem; } .ds-sheet a { color: var(--link, #22536c); font-weight: 750; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.09em; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-sheet a:hover { color: var(--link-hover, #122e40); text-decoration-thickness: 0.14em; } .ds-sheet a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #22536c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-sheet a:focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight; } }

components.name: Compact Ridgeline
components.description: Two static silhouettes fade into the sky ground below the introduction.
components.css: .ds-terrain { background: var(--sky, #e5edf0); } .ds-ridgeline { display: block; margin-inline-start: auto; inline-size: 84%; block-size: 1.85rem; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 26%, #000 93%, transparent); pointer-events: none; } .ds-ridge-far { fill: var(--ridge-far, #c7d8df); } .ds-ridge-near { fill: var(--ridge-near, #abc3cd); } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-ridgeline { display: none; } }

narrative.overview: A natural portrait introduces the person behind the writing. A low, two-layer ridge echoes the terrain in the photo: distinct enough to see, quiet enough to leave the words and portrait in charge. This is a personal publication for engineers and engineering leaders, not an engineering console or an extension of 10kR’s brand.
keyCharacteristics: One blue-gray ground, slate ink, and thin rules across the site.
Editorial headlines, plainspoken copy, and a quiet reading column.
dos: Do keep the portrait natural, the ridge legible but subordinate, and the reading ground free of decoration.
Do use plain labels, visible link states, and a clear keyboard focus indicator.
donts: Don't imitate 10kR or dress the publication as an engineering console.
Don't turn the portrait into a costume, the terrain into a spectacle, or the copy into editorial affectation.
